attributes.visState:
{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### PHP Versions, Crashes and Web Shells｜PHP 版本、異常終止與 Web Shell

`jt-php` · rules 133100-133199｜規則 133100-133199

不必等 Wazuh 的 CVE 資料，直接找出 PHP 少了 php.net 安全性版本、或所在分支已不再修補的每台 agent（level 12，會寄出）。另外偵測 PHP 主機被攻擊時留下的痕跡：PHP-FPM 工作程序與 PHP 程序被 SIGSEGV 等錯誤訊號終止、在任何程式執行前就記憶體耗盡、短時間內反覆當掉；php.ini 或 pool 設定被加上 auto_prepend_file、allow_url_include；上傳目錄出現 PHP 檔、.user.ini、.htaccess；網頁伺服器的 PHP 啟動 shell 與探查指令；PHP-CGI 參數注入。

Finds every agent whose PHP misses a php.net security release or runs a branch php.net no longer fixes, without waiting for Wazuh's CVE feed (level 12, mailed). Adds the signs exploitation leaves on a PHP host: PHP-FPM workers and PHP processes killed by SIGSEGV and similar faults, memory exhausted before any script ran, repeated crashes; php.ini or pool changes that add auto_prepend_file or allow_url_include; PHP files, .user.ini or .htaccess appearing in upload directories; shells and discovery commands started by the web server's PHP; PHP-CGI argument injection.

Discover query｜在 Discover 使用的查詢:

`rule.id:[133100 TO 133199] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-php · About｜說明","type":"markdown"}
